text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking down the hallway during
lunch
break, I hear loud voices coming
from the
stairway.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am Uma Lord Golshi! Bow down to me
as I stand
perched atop the world!
Desist!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! I'm no follower of yours!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good question! Long story short:
Golshi's
bein' the Uma Lord.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
She got hooked on this one RPG, and
now she's
been role playing in person all
day!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For I am the Uma Lord! The one who
stands on
top! At the summit! Now
then—you there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The top is the strongest! The strongest is
the top!
So answer me this, mortal: What
does it take to
get there?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Th-the top is the strongest?! The
strongest is the
top?! I got it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What you need is an unyielding heart! A
burning
spirit! The caliente will to fight!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, easy there, tiger. What are you
getting all
fired up for? You're not a
little kid, y'know? Cool
it already...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Plebeian earthlings. You know nothing!
Follow
me, and I shall teach you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I shall build my castle here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What comes with being at the top? A
castle! I'll
build a castle and stand at the
very top of it.
That'll make me the
strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That'll make you... the strongest? I see...
Makes
sense!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait... But if you just wanna stand
somewhere
high up, wouldn't the
rooftop of the academy be
good
enough?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa! Do you not wish to claim
the top
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you are indeed a condor, you must aim
for the
skies! The blue peak... Don't you
want the
mightiest throne for yourself?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhh... The mightiest throne! Sí! I sure
do!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then you'll need a castle! A grand
fortress with
spires soaring high above
mine own!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's survival of the fittest here... Strength
is the
will to rise above others, for only
then canst thou
change the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aw yeeeah! The strong! The
transcendent! The
battle for the top!
Things are heating up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right, let's get started! But first, what do
we do
about the castle?

El Condor Pasa appears to be getting
swept up in
Gold Ship's chaotic vibe. I
suppose if I have to
give her some
advice, then...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Arrr! Looks like we'll need us a fishing
boat, then!
One with cannons! We'll
defeat the Great King
Squid and
become the fishing kings, me matey!
choice_data_list: 城に使えそうなものを探すとか？

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, wait, it'd probably be faster to just
find some
hidden treasure. Yar-har! We
be sailing the high
seas as pirates, then!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What happened to being the Uma
Lord?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come on, ye landlubber! Ye can hop
onto me
ship, arrr!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The high seas await us! To the legendary
island!
Anchors aweeeigh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué?! I-I'm not going anywhere! I don't
want to
take to the se—AHHHHH?!

Gold Ship hoists up the reluctant El
Condor Pasa
and sets sail. I watch them
surge along the
Hallwayntic Ocean until
at last, they dip below
the distant
horizon...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Then I know just the place!

Gold Ship races over to the jungle gym,
climbs to
the top, and raises her hand in
a lofty manner.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I am Uma Lord Golshi! Come
at me,
El Condor Pasa the hero!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hero?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! As the world's strongest hero,
I'm
gonna drag you from that throne!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hey, what're you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ooh! I wanna play too!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I see you've brought some of your
underlings
to tip the scales! Excellent!
Just try to catch me!
HUP!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! You're Soldier A now, okay?
Remember
your line?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Perfect!

I watch for a while as Gold Ship and El
Condor
Pasa play out the battle of the
Uma Lord versus
the heroes.
